description: Business plans: puts a contact on call in a schedule from starts_at to ends_at (up to 90 days), instead of the rotation. Overrides may not overlap. Free.

alert_channel_id.description: The notification contact on call instead of the rotation.

ends_at.description: In the future, after starts_at and at most 90 days later. Overrides of a schedule may not overlap.

starts_at.description: When the override begins, as an ISO 8601 time.
